train_video_model: train a video classification model with distributed data parallel and mixed precision support
evaluate_video_model: evaluate a trained video classification model on validation data and return clip accuracy@1
train_one_epoch: run one training epoch for a video classification model with metric logging and learning rate scheduling
load_and_finetune_model: load a pretrained video model checkpoint and finetune on a custom number of classes with per-layer learning rates
resume_training: resume video model training from a saved checkpoint with optimizer and scheduler state restoration
